title: Terms of sale
body:
## 1. Who we are

This website is run by **Hallam Knight, trading as Knightlight Books**, a sole trader based in the UK. Address: {{address}}. Email: {{email}}. "We", "us" and "our" mean Knightlight Books.

## 2. These terms

These terms apply when you buy an e-book from us through this website. Nothing in them affects your statutory rights. Books bought from other retailers (Amazon, Kobo, Google Play) are covered by that retailer's terms.

## 3. Digital products

Our e-books are supplied as digital files (usually ePub). Checkout, payment and file delivery are handled by our payment provider, Payhip. Prices are shown in pounds sterling, and any VAT due on digital sales is calculated and collected at checkout.

## 4. Your licence

When you buy an e-book you get a personal, non-transferable licence to read it on your own devices. Please don't copy, share, resell or upload it anywhere else. All text, cover art and characters remain the copyright of Knightlight Books and its authors.

## 5. Cancellation and refunds

E-books are delivered immediately. At checkout you agree to the download starting straight away and acknowledge that you then lose your 14-day right to cancel under the Consumer Contracts Regulations. If a file is faulty, incomplete or won't open, contact us and we'll replace it or refund you, in line with the Consumer Rights Act 2015.

## 6. Age-restricted titles

Some titles contain adult content. By entering an age-restricted section or buying an age-restricted title you confirm you are 18 or over.

## 7. Our liability

We're responsible for losses that are a foreseeable result of our breaking these terms. We don't exclude liability where it would be unlawful to do so.

## 8. Complaints and law

If you're unhappy, email us and we'll aim to reply within 3 working days. These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales.
